user.title: Connect Zepp Life
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant reads your Zepp Life cloud account. The Zepp website session option is experimental and may avoid logging out the phone app.

menu_options.browser: Xiaomi sign-in (may log out phone app)

web_session.title: Use a Zepp website session
web_session.description: Sign in at https://watchface.zepp.com/ with the same linked account. In your browser's developer tools, find the hm-user-login-info cookie and copy only its Value into this form. Home Assistant extracts only the app token and user ID, then checks the scale records. Keep this cookie private; never paste it into chat. This experimental method may not work for every Zepp Life account. {error_detail}

data.member_id: Scale family member ID (-1 = main profile)

browser.title: Sign in to Xiaomi
browser.description: This login may log out the Zepp Life phone app. Open the Xiaomi sign-in URL shown in this form in a browser tab. Sign in and complete any verification. When the browser reaches the Zepp callback address, copy only the value after code= and before the next ampersand. Paste that code into Authorization here. The code expires, so submit it promptly. Never paste it into chat. {error_detail}

data.login_url: Xiaomi sign-in URL (copy and open in a browser tab)
data.authorization: Code from the callback URL (characters after code=)
data.member_id: Scale family member ID (-1 = main profile)

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Xiaomi / Zepp cloud.
error.wrong_account: Sign in to the same Zepp Life account and member as this entry.

init.title: Automatic cloud sync
init.description: Checks for measurements uploaded by the Zepp Life phone app. No Bluetooth receiver is needed at HA.
